verdict.rationale: The evidence documents that n8n has a public REST API, role-based access, and a library of third-party service credentials, but nothing shows the ability to issue scoped or least-privilege API keys for an agent. Role-based access and integration credentials are adjacent features, not scoped API credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
